summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K updating its agreed acquisition of European Lithium Ltd. (ASX: EUR) under a binding Scheme Implementation Deed dated May 18, 2026, structured as two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement covering all issued shares and listed options. On September 15, 2026, the Supreme Court of Western Australia ordered European Lithium to convene shareholder and optionholder meetings and approved dispatch of the registered Scheme Booklet, expected around September 22, 2026, after ASIC registration. No price per share, premium, break fee or closing date is stated in the excerpt; watch scheme-vote approval thresholds, optionholder treatment and any competing proposal risk.
